cards.program: Warrington MS in Finance and Technology
cards.schedule_note: Fall-only 1-year traditional track; first external class Fall 2027. Also offers UF-undergrad combination (4/5-yr) with combo first class Fall 2026 — intl slate should use traditional path.
cards.full_time_placement_notes: Inaugural traditional 1-year cohort starts Fall 2027 — no FinTech-program employment report exists yet. Do NOT substitute classic florida-msf (MS Finance combo) placement figures as this program's outcomes. Adjacent Warrington MS Finance (distinct restricted id florida-msf) publicly claims 100% placement Class of 2024–25 with avg start ~$102.8k — related college signal only, not transferable to florida-msft.
cards.notable_employers_notes: No florida-msft graduate employer list yet. Program marketing cites industry sectors (banks, fintech startups, investment firms, neobanks, consulting) and Florida fintech ecosystem (e.g. SoFi, Mastercard, MoonPay ops; FIS HQ) without program-specific hire counts.
cards.top_finance_firm_signal: Unknown for this degree. Curriculum aims fintech/AI/blockchain/DeFi + core finance; college has strong classic MSF IB/PE pipeline, but that pipeline is not evidenced for FinTech MS yet.
sample_alumni_paths: unknown (no graduates from traditional track yet)
Program-listed target titles (marketing, not outcomes): financial analyst, quantitative analyst, data analyst, blockchain developer, compliance/risk analyst
cards.referral_network_notes: Warrington Business Career Services coaching + recruitment events + alumni network claimed on program page. Fintech Research Center 12–16 week industry project. Florida fintech hub narrative. Strength of FinTech-specific employer referrals unproven until first class places.
cards.difficulty_notes: New program — recruiting brand thinner than classic UF MSF. STEM/CIP unstated on official FinTech pages (OPT STEM eligibility unclear). 3-year bachelor's from India/Australia/Bangladesh/Canada(excl Quebec)/Nepal/Pakistan not recognized by UF Admissions. Interview required if non-U.S. institution.
cards.intl_student_notes: Traditional 1-year track is the external/intl pathway (distinct from restricted florida-msf combo-only). English proficiency required; interview if attended non-U.S. institution. STEM designation unknown as of 2026-10-26.
cards.related_program_note: Keep florida-msf as restricted UF-UG combo classic MSF (TFE #11). florida-msft is separate FinTech MS on primary slate per Collinn lock 2026-10-26.
